title: qwen-launcher profile/v1
description: Calibrated performance envelopes for one model, engine, and hardware class.

schema.description: Versioned schema identifier for this profile.

id.description: Stable profile identifier, equal to the file name without its extension.

model.description: Complete model identifier used for calibration.

engine.description: Exact llama.cpp release used for calibration.

measured_on.description: Non-empty human-readable description of the calibration machine.

calibration_protocol.description: Calibration protocol that produced the selected envelopes.

calibration_report.description: Identifier of the accepted calibration report included in the package.

calibration_report_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes of the packaged calibration report.

benchmark_protocol.description: Benchmark protocol used to measure each valid candidate.

match.description: Hardware and platform constraints for profile selection.

modes.description: Calibrated envelopes keyed by mode identifier.

^[a-z0-9-]+$.description: Calibrated performance envelope for one mode.

range.description: Inclusive GiB range where null means no upper bound.

prefixItems.description: Inclusive maximum capacity in GiB, or null for no upper bound.

match.description: Profile matching constraints for backend, memory, and optional OS.

vram_gib.description: Inclusive nominal VRAM class in GiB.

ram_gib.description: Inclusive nominal system RAM class in GiB.

os.description: Supported operating systems when the profile is platform-specific.

items.description: Operating system covered by this profile.

envelope.description: Context and backend-specific values selected by calibration/v1.

ctx.description: Model context size selected for this mode.

n_cpu_moe.description: Experts assigned to CPU for a CUDA profile; forbidden for CPU profiles by semantic validation.
